import polars as pl

def dataframes_equal(df1: pl.DataFrame, df2: pl.DataFrame) -> bool:
    """Returns True if two polars DataFrames are exactly equal (same schema and values)."""
    return df1.frame_equal(df2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    df1 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 6]})
    df2 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 6]})
    df3 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 7]})
    df4 = pl.DataFrame({"x": [1, 2, 3], "y": [4, 5, 6]})
    
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df2))  # True
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df3))  # False (different values)
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df4))  # False (different schema)
